# AGENTS.md — Guidance for AI agents working in/on this repo

This repo is designed to be operated by agents. Two distinct modes:

## Mode 1: Consuming the index (most common)

You want assets for a user's Blender/Godot/Unreal project.

- CLI (stdlib-only): `python3 scripts/cc0a search <terms> [--kind kit]`, `info <id>`, `download <id> [--format ...] [--dir ...]`
- If the local checkout is stale or missing, `git clone https://github.com/Jpalmer95/cc0-asset-index` and run `python3 scripts/cc0a reindex`.
- **Every record is pre-cleared CC0.** Do not re-litigate licenses, do not add attribution boilerplate the user didn't ask for. Just report the source URL.
- Prefer `kind: kit` for environment scaffolding; single `model`s for props; `hdri` for lighting.
- Downloads land in `<dir>/cc0/<provider>/<slug>/` with `LICENSE.json` — leave that file in place; it is the provenance trail.
- Default formats: `.blend` for Blender, gltf for Godot 4, fbx for Unreal. Poly Haven gltf pulls texture includes which can be LARGE (900MB+ observed) — warn the user before batch gltf downloads; prefer `--format blend --res 1k` for scaffolding.
- "Vibe" requests ("cozy medieval tavern"): decompose into component terms, search each, compose a kit. Embedding search is on the roadmap, not built.

## Mode 2: Contributing to the index

You are adding sources, indexers, or tooling.

- Read CONTRIBUTING.md first. The CC0-only rule is absolute: if a source mixes licenses and you cannot filter to verified-CC0 records programmatically, do not index it.
- Indexers are Python stdlib only. No pip installs, no new deps. If a source needs a browser/JS to enumerate, fall back to a curated seed JSON (see `indexers/quaternius_seed.json`) rather than adding a dependency.
- Never commit asset binaries or generated `data/*.jsonl` / `data/index.sqlite` (gitignored — the index is regenerated by CI/reindex, not stored in git).
- Schema changes: extend, don't break. New optional fields are fine; renaming or removing fields breaks downstream consumers. Update `schema.json` and note it in MASTER_PLAN.md decisions.
- After changing an indexer, run `python3 scripts/cc0a reindex` and spot-check 3 records with `info`.
- Respect source rate limits: Poly Haven API is one call for the full asset list + one files-call per download; don't loop files-calls for thousands of assets.

## Repo layout

```
schema.json          record schema (source of truth for fields)
indexers/            one adapter per source (+ seed JSONs)
scripts/cc0a         the CLI: reindex/search/info/download
data/                generated index (gitignored)
collections/         (v1) curated asset-id bundles
MASTER_PLAN.md       decisions + roadmap — update when you change direction
CONTRIBUTING.md      human + license rules
```

## Hard don'ts

- Don't index anything that isn't verifiably CC0-equivalent. When in doubt, leave it out.
- Don't add runtime dependencies to the CLI or indexers.
- Don't hand-edit data/assets.jsonl — fix the indexer instead.
- Don't strip or relocate LICENSE.json files from downloaded asset dirs.
